keyFindings: No login wall encountered — hasLoginWall: false. The already-authenticated session (Ktrieling777@gmail.com) passed the isSkillEnabledForUser server gate and landed directly on /marketplace with no redirect.

CONFIRMED BUG (verified two ways this session): apps/mira-work/app/(agent)/marketplace/page.tsx redirects any user who fails isSkillEnabledForUser() to '/settings'. There is no app/(agent)/settings/page.tsx (only /settings/connectors/page.tsx and /settings/skills/... subpaths exist — confirmed via directory listing). Live navigation to https://mira-bff-preview.up.railway.app/settings was also performed directly and rendered the app's generic 'Page not found' / 'The page you are looking for does not exist or has been removed.' screen. Any user without skill access enabled who reaches /marketplace is bounced to a dead-end 404 instead of a meaningful settings/upsell page.

Category filter chips work correctly: clicking 'Sourcing' narrowed the grid to 1 matching listing, updated the counter to 'All skills (1)'/'1 total', and collapsed pagination to a single disabled Previous/Next; clicking 'All' correctly restored all 14 listings.

Pagination works correctly: page 1 shows 9 of 14 listings (Previous disabled, Next enabled); page 2 shows the remaining 5 listings (Previous enabled, Next disabled). Total counter correctly stays at 14 across both pages.

Minor data-quality note (not a UI bug): two seeded listings are both titled 'test111' with different descriptions/categories — headings are not unique, so getByRole('heading', { name: 'test111' }) will match 2 elements; downstream test/script generation should scope by description or install-count instead.

No data-testid attributes exist anywhere in marketplace-home-client.tsx; all locators must rely on getByRole+name or aria-label (pagination buttons and the installed-CTA carry aria-label from i18n; category chips/sort/install buttons rely on visible i18n text only).

i18n fixture gap (informational, not a live bug): the 'skill.marketplace' namespace used throughout this component does not exist in this QA workspace's messages/en.json — the live page still renders correct English text via its own bundled messages, so downstream scripts should use tolerant text/role matching rather than looking up skill.marketplace.* from the local fixture.
Not exercised (out of smoke scope): opening the sort dropdown, clicking 'Add to my skills' (avoided to prevent mutating shared test account state), and clicking into a listing card's detail page.
